Grad Cafe Analytics Documentation¶

This documentation describes the Grad Cafe Analytics application developed for Module 4.

The application includes a Flask web interface, GradCafe data processing, PostgreSQL storage, analysis queries, automated Pytest testing, and continuous integration with GitHub Actions.
